resources.string: Opt in to positive gain, preamplification and the limiter. Applied only in Track or Album mode. While off, playback keeps the previous attenuation-only behaviour.
Uses known file peaks and limits PCM sample peaks after EQ, linking channels. With it off, positive gain may clip. This is not a true-peak guarantee.

The adjustment is the PCM gain before dynamic limiting. Known peaks can reduce it; linked sample-peak limiting follows EQ. Device volume, focus and fades remain separate. Inter-sample peaks are not measured.
Track and album tags fall back to each other. When neither is present, the separate untagged preamp applies.
Positive gain and PCM controls for Track or Album mode.
Reduces PCM sample peaks with linked channels.
